{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Abrasion Blaster''' is used to dislodge visible surface deposits from an asteroid. It is commonly carried for [[Core Mining|core mining]], where a cracked asteroid exposes deposits that must be knocked loose before collection.

{{Draft warning}}

== Mining role ==

{{#invoke:Mining|equipmentNote|page=Abrasion Blaster}}

The abrasion blaster supports [[Surface Deposit Mining]] directly and often follows a successful core detonation. It does not replace a mining laser for ordinary fragments and does not collect anything by itself; collectors and a refinery still complete the loop.
